Power Stations | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, to be performed on an 
 annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
The first draft is initiated and tested by eng. Amr Moustafa,
accepted by eng. Nagy Nageeb Saleh: general manager, approved by eng. Khalaf 
Allah Mahmoud Abd El-Gaber: head
sector of Aswan Dam (1&2) power stations and certified 
by 
eng. Mohamed Osama 
Soliman:
HPGC 
quality control 
general director & MPIS Coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued
The maintenance staff should 
 carry the suitable ID safety category.
Maintenance staff should be 
 well trained, qualified or directly supervised by some one who is
Safety fence with caution 
 marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear the personal protective 
 equipment must used as safety shoes, safety helmet ...etc
Neutral Generator must be isolated 
 voltage from two sides ( IN OUT ).
Tools and Equipment
Megger
Hand tools
Voltage detector
Volt ohm meter
Fine cloth for cleaning 
 purposes
Work to be Carried Out
Clean the terminal.
Check perfect tightening of all terminals.
Test the protective devices.
Check the painting.
